realDependencyFailure.note: The genuine dependency failure is a Neon connection dropped mid-run; the system logged it, recorded it on the run, continued to the next unit and completed. stalenessAcrossRuns.note: Every staleness event here is evidence-based: a content hash that differed from the one previously stored for the same URL, with both recorded. No event is clock-based.
